hypothesis: A frozen recurrent model that receives only unlabeled from/to entity IDs and query endpoints cannot distinguish two worlds with identical graph topology and questions but different edge-relation roles. A typed four-role oracle must flip while frozen-model state and output remain invariant.

new_development_cohort.causal_mutation: Replace the third necessary path relation type with a different type, leaving every entity ID, edge endpoint, graph order and query unchanged.
controls: four-role typed reachability oracle must get 192/192 pairs
untyped exact reachability upper to show role-blindness
new_development_cohort.model: Frozen 22-param Y-F6 recurrent model, 576-byte unlabeled state, no training, no new state features or adapter
new_development_cohort.positive_limited_evidence: Information-theoretic role-channel gap, NOT native typed reasoning performance
invalid_conditions: role-blind frozen output changes for identical inputs
new_development_cohort.future_science: Prospectively add role-conditioned native state and learned role-composition with explicit entity/role permutation controls on new development cohorts; keep F3 frozen.
